id.description: A transient unique identifier to identify a volume within an ProvisioningConfig request.

gcpService.description: The GCP service of the network. Available gcp_service are in https://cloud.google.com/bare-metal/docs/bms-planning.

enumDescriptions: Client network, that is a network peered to a GCP VPC.
Private network, that is a network local to the BMS POD.
type.description: The type of this network, either Client or Private.

vlanAttachments.description: List of VLAN attachments. As of now there are always 2 attachments, but it is going to change in the future (multi vlan). Use only one of vlan_attachments or vrf

vlanSameProject.description: Whether the VLAN attachment pair is located in the same project.

jumboFramesEnabled.description: The JumboFramesEnabled option for customer to set.

vrf.description: Optional. The name of a pre-existing Vrf that the network should be attached to. Format is `vrfs/{vrf}`. If vrf is specified, vlan_attachments must be empty.

name.description: Output only. The name of the network config.

enumDescriptions: Services are disabled for the given network.
Use the highest /26 block of the network to host services.
Use the highest /27 block of the network to host services.
Use the highest /28 block of the network to host services.

bandwidth.description: Interconnect bandwidth. Set only when type is CLIENT.

NetworkConfig.description: Configuration parameters for a new network.

bandwidthGbps.description: The bandwidth permitted by the QOS policy, in gbps.

StartInstanceRequest.description: Message requesting to start a server.

EnableInteractiveSerialConsoleRequest.description: Message for enabling the interactive serial console on an instance.

ReimageInstanceRequest.description: Message requesting to perform reimage operation on a server.

osImage.description: Required. The OS image code of the image which will be used in the reimage operation.

sshKeys.description: Optional. List of SSH Keys used during reimaging an instance.

kmsKeyVersion.description: Optional. Name of the KMS crypto key version used to encrypt the initial passwords. The key has to have ASYMMETRIC_DECRYPT purpose. Format is `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/keyRings/{keyring}/cryptoKeys/{key}/cryptoKeyVersions/{version}`.

sizeGb.description: The requested size of each LUN, in GB.

enumDescriptions: ProvisioningConfig is a draft and can be freely modified.
ProvisioningConfig was already submitted and cannot be modified.
ProvisioningConfig was in the provisioning state. Initially this state comes from the work order table in big query when SNOW is used. Later this field can be set by the work order API.
ProvisioningConfig was provisioned, meaning the resources exist.
ProvisioningConfig was validated. A validation tool will be run to set this state.
The request is submitted for provisioning, with error return.

email.description: Email provided to send a confirmation with provisioning config to. Deprecated in favour of email field in request messages.

statusMessage.description: Optional status messages associated with the FAILED state.

customId.description: Optional. The user-defined identifier of the provisioning config.

name.description: Output only. The system-generated name of the provisioning config. This follows the UUID format.

cloudConsoleUri.description: Output only. URI to Cloud Console UI view of this provisioning config.

pod.description: Optional. Pod name. Pod is an independent part of infrastructure. Instance can be connected to the assets (networks, volumes, nfsshares) allocated in the same pod only.

vpcScEnabled.description: If true, VPC SC is enabled for the cluster.

ticketId.description: A generated ticket id to track provisioning request.

handoverServiceAccount.description: A service account to enable customers to access instance credentials upon handover.

location.description: Optional. Location name of this ProvisioningConfig. It is optional only for Intake UI transition period.

name.description: Output only. The name of the instance quota.

gcpService.description: The gcp service of the provisioning quota.

availableMachineCount.description: Number of machines than can be created for the given location and instance_type.

StartInstanceResponse.description: Response message from starting a server.

StopInstanceResponse.description: Response message from stopping a server.

address.description: IPv4 address to be assigned to the server.

networkId.description: Id of the network to use, within the same ProvisioningConfig request.

existingNetworkId.description: Name of the existing network to use.

routerIp.description: The router IP of the attachment.

id.description: Immutable. The identifier of the attachment within vrf.

peerIp.description: The peer IP of the attachment.

peerVlanId.description: The peer vlan ID of the attachment.

interconnectAttachment.description: Optional. The name of the vlan attachment within vrf. This is of the form projects/{project_number}/regions/{region}/interconnectAttachments/{interconnect_attachment}

qosPolicy.description: The QOS policy applied to this VLAN attachment. This value should be preferred to using qos at vrf level.

StopInstanceRequest.description: Message requesting to stop a server.

applicableInstanceTypes.description: Instance types this image is applicable to. [Available types](https://cloud.google.com/bare-metal/docs/bms-planning#server_configurations)

name.description: Output only. OS Image's unique name.

supportedNetworkTemplates.description: Network templates that can be used with this OS Image.

performanceTier.description: Immutable. Performance tier of the Volume. Default is SHARED.

enumDescriptions: Don't delete any snapshots. This disables new snapshot creation, as long as the snapshot reserved space is full.
snapshotAutoDeleteBehavior.description: The behavior to use when snapshot reserved space is full.

attached.description: Output only. Is the Volume attached at at least one instance. This field is a lightweight counterpart of `instances` field. It is filled in List responses as well.

requestedSizeGib.description: The requested size of this storage volume, in GiB.

snapshotReservationDetail.description: Details about snapshot space reservation and usage on the storage volume.

bootVolume.description: Output only. Whether this volume is a boot volume. A boot volume is one which contains a boot LUN.

maxSizeGib.description: Maximum size volume can be expanded to in case of evergency, in GiB.

protocol.description: Output only. Storage protocol for the Volume.
enumDescriptions: NFS protocol means Volume is a NFS Share volume. Such volumes cannot be manipulated via Volumes API.

remainingSpaceGib.description: The space remaining in the storage volume for new LUNs, in GiB, excluding space reserved for snapshots.

notes.description: Input only. User-specified notes for new Volume. Used to provision Volumes that require manual intervention.

instances.description: Output only. Instances this Volume is attached to. This field is set only in Get requests.

currentSizeGib.description: The current size of this storage volume, in GiB, including space reserved for snapshots. This size might be different than the requested size if the storage volume has been configured with auto grow or auto shrink.

enumDescriptions: The storage type for this volume is unknown.
The storage type for this volume is SSD.
This storage type for this volume is HDD.
storageType.description: The storage type for this volume.

name.description: Output only. The resource name of this `Volume`. Resource names are schemeless URIs that follow the conventions in https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/resource_names. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/volumes/{volume}`

pod.description: Immutable. Pod name. Pod is an independent part of infrastructure. Volume can only be connected to the instances allocated in the same pod.

workloadProfile.description: The workload profile for the volume.
enumDescriptions: The workload profile is in an unknown state.

expireTime.description: Output only. Time after which volume will be fully deleted. It is filled only for volumes in COOLOFF state.

autoGrownSizeGib.description: The size, in GiB, that this storage volume has expanded as a result of an auto grow policy. In the absence of auto-grow, the value is 0.

id.description: An identifier for the `Volume`, generated by the backend.

state.description: The state of this storage volume.
enumDescriptions: The storage volume is in an unknown state.
The storage volume is being created.
The storage volume is ready for use.
The storage volume has been requested to be deleted.
The storage volume is being updated.
The storage volume is in cool off state. It will be deleted after `expire_time`.

emergencySizeGib.description: Additional emergency size that was requested for this Volume, in GiB. current_size_gib includes this value.

enumDescriptions: The Network is in an unknown state.

id.description: An identifier for the `Network`, generated by the backend.

jumboFramesEnabled.description: Whether network uses standard frames or jumbo ones.

name.description: Output only. The resource name of this `Network`. Resource names are schemeless URIs that follow the conventions in https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/resource_names. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/networks/{network}`

servicesCidr.description: IP range for reserved for services (e.g. NFS).

vrfAttachment.description: Optional. The name of a pre-existing Vrf that the network should be attached to. Format is `vrfs/{vrf}`.

vlanId.description: The vlan id of the Network.

reservations.description: List of IP address reservations in this network. When updating this field, an error will be generated if a reservation conflicts with an IP address already allocated to a physical server.

mountPoints.description: Input only. List of mount points to attach the network to.

vrf.description: The Vrf for the Network. Use this only if a new Vrf needs to be created.

pod.description: Immutable. Pod name. Pod is an independent part of infrastructure. Network can only be connected to the assets (instances, nfsshares) allocated in the same pod.

enumDescriptions: Client network, a network peered to a Google Cloud VPC.
Private network, a network local to the Bare Metal Solution environment.

ListLunsResponse.description: Response message containing the list of storage volume luns.

unreachable.description: Locations that could not be reached.

nextPageToken.description: A token identifying a page of results from the server.

EvictVolumeRequest.description: Request for skip volume cooloff and delete it.

https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-pl.description: See, edit, configure, and delete your Google Cloud data and see the email address for your Google Account.
